title: Fate Returns Our Destined Love
description: A high-stakes billionaire drama following Ethan, a powerful CEO who discovers a secret son with his former love Grace, sparking a public scandal, corporate power struggles, and a second chance at romance.
descriptionMore: Years after a sudden separation, Ethan, the CEO of Lancaster Group, unexpectedly reconnects with Grace and discovers she has been secretly raising his son, Leo. When the truth is exposed at a high-profile corporate gala, the public revelation triggers an immediate media scandal and a ruthless battle over family inheritance. Caught between interfering relatives, business rivals, and unresolved pain, Ethan and Grace must work together to safeguard their child's future. As they navigate the chaos, they are forced to confront their past and decide if fate is giving them a genuine second chance at love.
